errors.evidence: The machine-generated description incorrectly labels the x-axis of the right graph as 'ρ' instead of 'p', which is clearly shown in the figure.
The machine-generated description states BLEU values of 28.4 for ρ = 0.25, ρ = 0.35, and ρ = 0.45, but the figure shows BLEU values of 28.38, 28.44, and 28.40, respectively.
The machine-generated description does not explicitly state that the charts illustrate the impact of parameters α and p on BLEU scores, which is clearly indicated in the reference description.
The machine-generated description omits the tick interval information for the x-axis of both graphs (0.2 for α and 0.1 for p), which is explicitly mentioned in the reference description.
The machine-generated description does not mention the comparative impact of α and p on BLEU scores, as highlighted in the reference description (e.g., α has a larger impact than p).
